title: 第十三章 战斗余波第十四章 交换
lines: 挑战之日过后，春天逐渐临近。
四季女神向大地撒出勃发的生机，赭石谷一改往日灰蒙蒙的面貌。
映着琥珀光的溪流愈发清澈，铁叶木接连抽出新芽，雏黄色的金雀小花，一下子就从岩石缝里开到了天边。
风把树林摇得叮当作响，溪水从铁木林环绕而过，几簇嫩绿的叶片落进水里，拥着丛生的虾蟹鱼群，一起向山谷的湾湖汨汨淌去。
湾湖并非天然生成，而是古早矿脉被掘空后塌陷出的巨大凹地，地下暗河从裂开的岩层里年复一年灌入其中，最终把废弃矿道、赤铁断层和焦黑的炉渣一并淹没，养成了这片嵌在赭石谷腹地的冷湖。
因为曾是矿脉的缘故，雏龙们很是将此视作一块宝地。
常有小龙在此曳游潜水、探索寻宝，也有雏龙在湖畔捕猎鱼虾，追踪蘑菇人和小石灵。
午后，湾湖边的雏龙已经聚集了不少。
若是从上方走过，就能看见一群岩石旁边的钨龙镍龙，正围着一条铬龙七嘴八舌。
“莱杰多雷”、“西隆”、“希多里维”这样的名词，从龙群里断断续续飘出来，偶尔伴着一声惊奇的吼叫，或者一记砸在地上的爪子。
这段时间小龙们聚在一块，嘴上说来闹去，最后总少不了废弃矿洞外的那场决斗。
赭石谷里养育着大量雏龙，彼此之间打斗从来不缺，倘若仅仅是一条雏龙击败另一条雏龙，大家说几句可能也就算了。
可那一场非同小可，铁龙与铬龙的决斗，败者反倒竟是铁龙。
那只铁龙还不是龙群之耻莱杰多雷，而是在龙群里排名第二的铁龙，希多里维·烬痕。
希多里维的名字，山谷里的雏龙都是知道的，他是真正依靠力量取得龙群尊敬的强大者，而不是凭借“烬痕”这个姓氏。
所以就连战斗结束，希多里维当众认输的姿态，也被视作铁龙的骄傲坦荡，成了雏龙们反复传播的话题。
此时此刻，湾湖西岸的铬龙眉飞色舞，尾巴快要甩到天上去了，正绘声绘色给围观者演示，旁边还有几个小家伙添油加醋，都跟亲身经历似的，说得比谁都详细。
它们讲的起劲，马上开始表演起来。
一条钨龙模仿着希多里维的样子，大吼着“楔式”，而那条铬龙闪转腾挪、倒退出去，接着又忽一转身，反手把钨龙按在地上。
钨龙耷拉着脑袋，垂头丧气认输，而铬龙张牙舞爪，昂着头威风八面。
这样的吵闹，隐约飘到了另一侧湖畔。
湾湖东岸一处背风岩洞里，几条次龙挺直脊背踞坐，山龙、棘龙、荧龙都有，它们正睁大眼睛，磕磕绊绊辨认着石面上的古代龙文。
在凡人世界，常有“巨龙骑士”、“唤龙者”之类的称号流传，这些称号倒也不是胡编乱造，只是凡人所驯服的龙，大多都是飞龙、龙血魔兽。
血统最高，也只是次龙。
次龙之所以被称作次龙，是因为它们虽然有巨龙的躯体和形状，却没有血源龙神的庇佑扶持，它们的神或许在百万年前就陨落了，又或者根本不曾存在过。
因此，次龙根本没有赋予后代传承的能力，一条新生的次龙，连最基本的语言、文字，都要从头开始学起。
这样的龙，即便拥有力量，也无法理解龙之血统的高贵，更无法对龙类的辉煌历史感同身受。
它们数量广泛、种类极多，因为生而无知，常常与那些真龙视作奴隶、仆从的短命种混在一起，甚至遭到驯养，担任短命种的战宠、坐骑。
这是真龙绝对无法忍受的，为了将自身与这样的龙区别开来，在龙类世界里，所有不具备龙之传承的巨龙，一律都被称作次龙。
就连善龙之神巴哈姆特，也同样认可这个定义。
“我们不应该纠结真龙与次龙的定义，而是应当全力行动起来，给次龙教化，帮助它们独立自主、重拾尊严。”
关于次龙，善龙之神曾经这样说。
content_en:
After the challenging day, spring is approaching.
The goddess of the four seasons spreads vitality to the earth, and the ocher valley changes from its previous gray appearance.
The stream reflecting the amber light became clearer and clearer, the iron leaf trees sprouted new buds one after another, and the young yellow gorse flowers suddenly bloomed from the cracks in the rocks to the horizon.
The wind shook the woods to a tinkling sound, and the stream flowed through the ironwood forest. A few clusters of tender green leaves fell into the water, and surrounded by clusters of shrimps, crabs and fish, they flowed toward the bay lake in the valley.
Bay Lake is not naturally formed, but a huge depression that collapsed after the ancient ore veins were dug out. The underground river poured into it year after year from the cracked rock formations, eventually submerging the abandoned mine tunnels, hematite faults and blackened slag, creating this cold lake embedded in the hinterland of the Ocher Valley.
Because it was once a mine, the young dragons regarded this as a treasure.
There are often little dragons swimming and diving here, exploring and hunting for treasures, and there are also young dragons hunting fish and shrimps by the lake, tracking mushrooms and small stone spirits.
In the afternoon, a lot of baby dragons had gathered by the Bay Lake.
If you walk from above, you can see a group of tungsten dragons and nickel dragons beside the rocks, chattering around a chrome dragon.
Terms like "Legedore", "Shillong", and "Hidorivi" floated out intermittently from the group of dragons, occasionally accompanied by a roar of surprise or a claw hitting the ground.
During this time, the little dragons gathered together, chatting and making trouble, and in the end, the duel outside the abandoned mine was inevitable.
There are a large number of young dragons raised in the Ocher Valley, and there is never a shortage of fights between them. If it is just one young dragon defeating another young dragon, everyone may just say a few words and forget it.
But that was an extraordinary duel between the Iron Dragon and the Chrome Dragon, and the loser was actually the Iron Dragon.
That iron dragon was not Legedore, the shame of the dragons, but the second-ranked iron dragon among the dragons, Hedorivi Emberhen.
Hidorivi's name is known to all the young dragons in the valley. He is a powerful person who truly relies on his strength to gain the respect of the dragons, not on the surname "Ember Mark".
Therefore, even after the battle, Hedorivi's gesture of admitting defeat in public was regarded as the iron dragon's pride and magnanimity, and became a topic repeatedly spread among the young dragons.
At this moment, the chrome dragon on the west bank of Bay Lake was dancing with its eyebrows flying, and its tail was about to swing into the sky. It was demonstrating vividly to the onlookers, and there were a few little guys beside it who were adding more details to it, as if they had experienced it personally, and explained it in more detail than anyone else.
They spoke enthusiastically and immediately started performing.
A tungsten dragon imitated Hedorivi's appearance, shouting "wedge", while the chrome dragon flashed around, backed away, then suddenly turned around and pinned the tungsten dragon to the ground with its backhand.
The tungsten dragon drooped its head and surrendered in despair, while the chrome dragon bared its teeth and claws, holding its head high and looking majestic.
The noise drifted faintly to the other side of the lake.
In a leeward cave on the east coast of Bay Lake, several subsaurs were sitting with their backs straight, including mountain dragons, spinosaurs, and glow dragons. They were opening their eyes wide and stumbling to identify the ancient dragon inscriptions on the stone surface.
In the mortal world, titles such as "Dragon Knight" and "Dragon Caller" are often circulated. These titles are not made up randomly, but most of the dragons tamed by mortals are flying dragons and dragon-blooded monsters.
The one with the highest bloodline is only a sub-dragon.
The reason why secondary dragons are called secondary dragons is because although they have the body and shape of a giant dragon, they do not have the blessing and support of the blood dragon god. Their god may have fallen millions of years ago, or may have never existed at all.
Therefore, Cilong has no ability to pass on to future generations. A new Cilong must learn even the most basic language and writing from scratch.
Such a dragon, even if it has power, cannot understand the nobility of dragon bloodline, let alone empathize with the glorious history of dragons.
They are widespread in number and of many types. Because they are born ignorant, they are often mixed with the short-lived species that true dragons regard as slaves and servants. They are even domesticated and serve as the battle pets and mounts of the short-lived species.
This is something that true dragons absolutely cannot tolerate. In order to distinguish themselves from such dragons, in the world of dragons, all giant dragons that do not have the heritage of dragons are called secondary dragons.
Even Bahamut, the Good Dragon God, also recognizes this definition.
"We should not be entangled in the definition of true dragons and secondary dragons, but should take full action to educate secondary dragons and help them become independent and regain their dignity."
Regarding the second dragon, the god of good dragons once said this.
